propositions: Expected best-effort push failures due to contention races and transient transport retries are logged at WARNING/INFO, causing LLM agent sessions to waste tokens investigating non-issues and assume the store is broken.
Lost-contention branch push failures (non-fast-forward rejects, auto-recovered) emit raw git stderr pattern-matched as corruption to agents, priming false outage assumption.

Mid-retry transient transport notices are logged despite the code already retrying; the backlog suffix uses bare `..HEAD` which reads as the session's worktree HEAD rather than the tracker's HEAD, escalating concern across concurrent writers.
Expected-case push outcomes must emit nothing at INFO or above (DEBUG at most) while preserving loud warnings for policy declines, strict-mode failures, and proven-growing backlogs.
Backlog messages must name the tickets branch explicitly with self-healing contract stated in-text, and prove backlog growth against the prior marker before escalating to WARNING.

Mid-retry transient-transport notices at all three emission sites (push_classify, push_recovery merge-leg, push_recovery fetch-leg) must be demoted from INFO to DEBUG with 'retrying automatically, no action needed' wording.
